$schema-note: Congdon & Coleman design tokens — single source of truth. Destination: strategy/brands/assets/congdon-coleman/tokens.json. Every hex in cnc-web-fe must trace here; cc-design-tokens.css derives from this file. 'Token' means design-system token only (transactional-link tokens are TR-1 vocabulary).
source: Brand & Identity Guidelines, Third Edition (Ecosystem Revision), August 2026. Supersedes v1.0, which derived from the single-page C&C Style Guide PDF.

decisions: D-1 — canonical ink. v1.0 ratified #092A35 and retired #082A34. RESOLVED 2026-08-14 (Stephen) the other way: #082A34 is canonical, #092A35 retired. The two are visually identical (contrast ratio 1.002); #082A34 is the value in the Third Edition and in every exported logo asset, so no logo re-export is required and v1.0's re-export audit flag is closed.
D-2 — ground. Warm Paper #F8F7F4 replaces v1.0's white-primary; Mist #EEF1F2 replaces #EEF2F4 as the cool alt surface.

D-3 — typography. Kiona and Poppins are retired from the type system. Interim faces Libre Caslon Display/Text + Archivo (Google Fonts, OFL, self-hosted via next/font) ship now; Kings Caslon + Founders Grotesk replace them when licensed. This also closes RIGHTS-1: no Kiona webfont is needed.

ink.role: Default text; primary actions; formal fields and dark surfaces (~18% of a layout, §3.2)

ink-hover.role: Primary button hover only (§8.1). Never a surface, never text

ink-active.role: Primary button pressed state only (§8.1). Never a surface, never text

harbor.role: Descriptors, secondary labels, rules. UI and large text only on light grounds (4.2:1)

harbor-deep.role: Secondary body text and captions on light grounds — 7.4:1 on Paper (AAA). Harbor itself is too light for small text (§3.3)

slate.role: The roundel, quiet accents, decorative rules; text on Ink only (5.9:1)

paper.role: Default page ground — warm-neutral, never blue-white (~68% of a layout with Mist and Sand)

mist.role: Cool panels, form-field surrounds, quiet cards, content division

fog.role: Hairlines, table rules, disabled fills. Hairlines before shadows (§8)

sand.role: Warm panels on print-leaning surfaces and report sidebars

brass.role: Micro-accent ONLY, ≤2% of any layout: focus rings, active-page indicators, tenure rules. Never a fill behind text (3.1:1)

brass-deep.role: Brass as text — small labels, tenure lines — where Brass itself fails contrast (5.5:1 on Paper)

signal-brick.role: FUNCTIONAL ONLY: form errors and destructive confirmation. Never decorative, never in marketing

signal-moss.role: FUNCTIONAL ONLY: form success and confirmation states

disabled-text.role: Label on a Fog-filled disabled control only (§8.1). Prefer hiding over disabling on mobile

white.role: Card fills on Paper; always behind the logo; secondaries never as logo backgrounds

dark-mode.scope: NOT IMPLEMENTED on this site by design (§8.4). The marketing site is always light — Paper ground is part of the identity, and split renderings would fracture recognition for no counsel benefit. These values exist for utility surfaces elsewhere (long-form report reading, form flows) that honour the OS preference. Any hex adopted here must first be added to colors above, or the token checker will fail it.

retired.reason: D-1, resolved 2026-08-14. Near-duplicate ink (contrast ratio 1.002 vs #082A34) consolidated into the Third Edition value, which is what every exported logo asset already uses. Previously canonical under v1.0.
v1.0 'secondary-3', large-text-and-UI-only. The Third Edition covers that role with Harbor #5E7B87 and gives small text Harbor Deep #3E565F, so the intermediate value has no remaining job.
v1.0 alt surface. Replaced by the marginally warmer Mist, which sits correctly against the Paper ground adopted in D-2.

display.interim: Libre Caslon Display (Google Fonts, OFL — in production until the licence is acquired)
display.usage: H1/H2, report covers, headline moments. Sentence case, never tracked. One display moment per page
display.rights: Dalton Maag — commercial licence TO ACQUIRE [AUDIT]

body-serif.usage: Long-form body: letters, reports, page prose. 17px/26 mobile, 18px/28 desktop

sans.usage: UI, labels, buttons, data tables, captions, credentials, legal. Buttons: Medium 15px, tracking +0.02em
sans.rights: Klim Type Foundry — commercial licence TO ACQUIRE [AUDIT]

typography.pairing_rule: Serif for judgment, grotesque for apparatus. A page that is all-grotesque reads product; all-serif reads antique. Both faces appear on every substantive page. No sibling brand uses a serif as its primary voice — the serif itself is the distinctness device (§4)

retired-faces.reason: Retired from the type system per Third Edition §4. Geometric display reads tech-product. Its webfont rights were unverified (RIGHTS-1); retiring it closes that gate rather than resolving it. The wordmark is outlined artwork and is unaffected
Retired — geometric sans reads tech-product; replaced by Founders Grotesk, interim Archivo

geometry.radius_rationale: The near-square corner is a brand signature — rounder is friendlier and less precise, and precision is the product
geometry.shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(8,42,52,0.08) — one level, cards and sheets only; hairlines before shadows

motion.reveals: 12px rise + fade, once per load, max 3-item stagger at 60ms
motion.parallax: desktop hero photo only, ≤6% travel; none on mobile

governance.proportion_rule: ~68% Paper/Mist/Sand, ~18% Ink, ~12% Slate and Harbor, ≤2% Brass (Third Edition §3.2 — replaces v1.0's 85%-main rule)
governance.accent_verdict: The primary CTA is an Ink fill (option A, §3.2). A Brass fill primary was tested and rejected: 3.1:1 against white, and at button scale it reads promotional — closer to a booking platform than counsel
governance.reserved_labels: 'Speak with an advisor' and 'Request a confidential valuation' are the two conversion actions; their wording is fixed (§8.1)
governance.logo_rules: Light quiet grounds only (Paper, white, Mist, Sand, or genuinely light photographic areas). One-color Paper knockout for Ink grounds PENDING PRODUCTION — use the typeset treatment until it ships, never a recoloured logo file (§2.3)
governance.lint: Any hex in code not present in this file = audit finding. Retired hexes fail wherever they appear, including untouched files
governance.contrast_law: Approved pairings per Third Edition §3.3; pairings not listed are build errors

open_findings.finding: D-1 closes v1.0's re-export audit flag on the grounds that #082A34 is 'the value in the Third Edition and in every exported logo asset, so no logo re-export is required'. Measured, the second clause is false: the mark still ships in the retired navy.
evidence: odin - SEVEN marks decode to opaque #092A35, not one: cma_report/static/cnc-logo-cover.png and cnc-icon.png, and public/images/cnc-icon.png, cnc-logo-clean.png, cnc-logo-cover.png, cnc-logo-only.png and cnc-logo2.png. Each carries it across 30-92% of its opaque pixels.

The reach is wider than the listing sheet. cnc-logo-cover.png is the mark the Odin listing sheet renders, so every generated sheet embeds it; cnc-icon.png is rendered by CmaPrintFooter and by the WeasyPrint page_footer partial, so it is on EVERY page of every client CMA.

cnc-web-fe public/brand/congdon-coleman-logo-no-since.svg and the four marks under docs/brand-guide/assets/brand/ - same value, in the .st2 fill. Those five are vector and are corrected on cnc-web-fe#33; the odin seven are raster and are not fixable in a branch.
scripts/design-tokens/check.mjs decodes every raster in the artwork directories on each run and check.test.mjs pins the footer icon, so the finding cannot go quiet.
open_findings.why_it_stayed_invisible: A hex sweep reads text, and the claim was only ever checked against source. Nothing decoded the artwork until the check that raised this.
open_findings.status: open - needs an approved re-export of all seven odin rasters from whoever owns the artwork. The brand guide forbids a contributor recolouring, restyling or rearranging the mark, so this is not a code fix and no branch should attempt one.
open_findings.does_not_amend: D-1's decision text above is left exactly as ratified. This records what was measured against it; only the owner may change the decision itself.
open_findings.first_recorded_as: one file. This entry said only cnc-logo-cover.png on 2026-09-21 because the check took a hand-written list of assets; globbing the artwork directories instead found six more the same day. A hand-written list is the same failure as a hand-copied token record, which is what this whole finding is about.
open_findings.not_in_scope: cma_report/static/placeholder_{subject,comp,map}.png are NOT part of this finding. They are generic 'photo unavailable' furniture rather than the ratified mark, so recolouring them is permitted, and they were migrated to Third Edition tokens and re-exported from their SVG sources on 2026-09-21 (cma_report/assets/render_placeholders.py). The traces of #092A35 the check still reports in two of them are antialiased edges against the canonical #082A34, which differs by one unit per channel - reported with their pixel counts, and not artwork debt.
